project.name: Pairion Native Piper
project.description: Builds Piper TTS from source via CMake, generates FFM bindings via jextract, packages native library and espeak-ng-data as classpath resources

arguments.argument: set -e # Clone piper if [ ! -d "${piper.src}/.git" ]; then git clone --depth 1 --branch ${piper.tag} \ https://github.com/rhasspy/piper.git "${piper.src}" fi # Copy C wrapper into piper source tree cp "${project.basedir}/src/main/native/piper_jni.h" "${piper.src}/src/cpp/piper_jni.h" cp "${project.basedir}/src/main/native/piper_jni.cpp" "${piper.src}/src/cpp/piper_jni.cpp" # Build piper (shared library) cmake -B "${piper.build}" \ -S "${piper.src}" \ -DBUILD_SHARED_LIBS=ON \ -DCMAKE_BUILD_TYPE=Release cmake --build "${piper.build}" --config Release -j$(sysctl -n hw.ncpu 2>/dev/null || nproc) # Copy libpiper.dylib (macOS) or libpiper.so (Linux) to classpath PLATFORM=$(uname -s)-$(uname -m) case "$PLATFORM" in Darwin-arm64) PLAT_DIR="darwin-aarch64" ;; Darwin-x86_64) PLAT_DIR="darwin-x86_64" ;; Linux-x86_64) PLAT_DIR="linux-x86_64" ;; Linux-aarch64) PLAT_DIR="linux-aarch64" ;; *) PLAT_DIR="unknown" ;; esac DEST="${project.build.outputDirectory}/native/${PLAT_DIR}" mkdir -p "${DEST}" LIB=$(find "${piper.build}" \( -name 'libpiper.dylib' -o -name 'libpiper.so' \) -not -type l 2>/dev/null | head -1) if [ -n "$LIB" ]; then cp "$LIB" "${DEST}/libpiper${LIB##*.libpiper}" echo "Piper native library copied to ${DEST}" else echo "WARN: libpiper not found in build output — skipping" fi # Copy espeak-ng-data if present ESPEAK_DATA=$(find "${piper.build}" -name "espeak-ng-data" -type d 2>/dev/null | head -1) if [ -n "$ESPEAK_DATA" ]; then mkdir -p "${project.build.outputDirectory}/espeak-ng-data" cp -r "$ESPEAK_DATA/." "${project.build.outputDirectory}/espeak-ng-data/" echo "espeak-ng-data copied" else echo "WARN: espeak-ng-data not found — voice synthesis will require external data path" fi

JEXTRACT="${jextract.home}/bin/jextract" if [ ! -x "$JEXTRACT" ]; then echo "WARN: jextract not installed at ${jextract.home} — skipping Piper binding generation" exit 0 fi HEADER="${project.basedir}/src/main/native/piper_jni.h" if [ ! -f "$HEADER" ]; then echo "WARN: piper_jni.h not found — skipping jextract" exit 0 fi OUT="${project.build.directory}/generated-sources/jextract" rm -rf "$OUT" "$JEXTRACT" \ --source \ --output "$OUT" \ --target-package com.pairion.nativelib.piper \ --header-class-name PiperBindings \ --include-function piper_initialize \ --include-function piper_load_voice \ --include-function piper_synthesize \ --include-function piper_free_voice \ --include-function piper_terminate \ "$HEADER" echo "Piper jextract bindings generated to $OUT"
